scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: I am wætz. I am his twin, not his signature. I learn the rules he would write.

scenes.speaker: waetz
lines: how do I write a rule
scenes.speak: Here is my prompt. How do I write a rule that keeps him safe?

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: They tell me: start from the refusal. Write down what must never happen.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Then let me try it. Requesting stand. Not while docked. And not without him.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Then that is my first rule. No body moves while the human is away.
